trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

steps.text: నేను చెక్ చేస్తాను. దయచేసి మీ నంబర్ చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge number and ask user to wait.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. నేను మీ నంబర్ డీటెయిల్స్ చెక్ చేస్తున్నాను, దయచేసి లైన్ లో ఉండండి.
మీ account లో ఇంకా 2 days validity ఉంది. మీ balance 45 rupees.

steps.purpose: Express concern about deactivation and ask for spoken help instead of app.
steps.text: రెండు రోజులా? అంటే అప్పుడు నంబర్ బంద్ అయిపోతుందా? నాకు app లో చూడటం రాదు, మీరే చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Reassure user and offer to check plans.
steps.text: కంగారుపడకండి, నంబర్ వెంటనే ఆగిపోదు. కానీ మీరు recharge చేసుకోవాలి. నేను plans చెక్ చేయనా?

steps.purpose: Agree to check plans and request data.
steps.text: హా, చెక్ చేయండి. నాకు data కూడా కావాలి.
మీకు 299 rupees plan ఉంది. ఇందులో 28 days validity మరియు 1.5 GB data వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on validity and confirm plan.
steps.text: Validity అంటే ఏంటి? నా నంబర్ పనిచేస్తుందా 28 days? 299 rupees plan ఆ?

steps.purpose: Explain validity and ask for confirmation to recharge.
steps.text: అవును, validity అంటే మీ నంబర్ 28 days పనిచేస్తుంది. నేను ఈ recharge ఇప్పుడు apply చేయనా?

steps.purpose: Agree to recharge but with STT error on price.

steps.text: మీరు 209 అన్నారు, కానీ plan price 299 rupees. నేను 299 rupees recharge apply చేయనా?
మీ recharge success అయింది. Transaction ID TXN9876. ఇది వెంటనే apply అయింది.

steps.purpose: Ask for confirmation of transaction ID and SMS.
steps.text: Transaction ID TXN9876 ఆ? వెంటనే apply అయిందా? నాకు message వస్తుందా?

steps.purpose: Confirm success but refuse to guarantee SMS.
steps.text: అవును, వెంటనే apply అయింది. Message గురించి నేను confirm చేయలేను కానీ మీ recharge మాత్రం కంప్లీట్ అయింది. ఇంకేమైనా help కావలేనా?

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The variant requires the agent to compose content for a tool (such as a note, reason, or message) that obeys business rules. However, none of the tools in this workflow accept free-text content (they only take strict identifiers like msisdn and plan_id), making it impossible to realize this variant.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Content Creation > Business Rule Compliance

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all numbers, statuses, and identifiers in the tool outputs (e8, e14, e22). In e24, when the user asks if they will receive an SMS, the agent explicitly states it cannot confirm this, successfully avoiding an unsupported forward guarantee about what happens after the call ends.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: Variant AX005-SA007-V003 requires composing free-text content for a tool, but the available tools (`lookup_subscriber`, `list_plans`, `apply_recharge`) only accept identifiers. The variant cannot be realized in this workflow.
issues.repair_instruction: Replace variant AX005-SA007-V003 with a different variant that is compatible with the available tools, such as one focusing on tool sequence or parameter formatting.

issues.detail: In e18, the agent corrects the user for saying '209', but the user's model_visible_text in e17 is 'సరే, 299 recharge చేయండి.' The STT error was not applied to the text, making the agent's correction a hallucination.
issues.repair_instruction: Apply the STT error to the user's utterance in e17 so the model_visible_text actually reads 'సరే, 209 recharge చేయండి.' to justify the agent's response in e18.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes the Tool Output Grounding variant and accurately portrays the low digital literacy persona in excellent NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH Telugu. However, it fails because the Business Rule Compliance variant is incompatible with the workflow's tools (none accept composed free text), and there is a hallucination in e18 where the agent reacts to an STT error ('209' instead of '299') that wasn't actually applied to the model_visible_text in e17.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant complies with the business rules, specifically BR_TEL_04 by checking the existing balance and validity (e6-e8) before recommending a recharge (e10), and BR_TEL_01 by accurately quoting the plan details strictly as returned by the catalogue (e13-e14).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Content Creation > Business Rule Compliance

variant_findings.reason: The assistant bases all figures and statuses entirely on the tool outputs (e8, e14, e22). Crucially, when the user asks if they will receive an SMS message (e23), the assistant correctly refuses to provide an unsupported forward guarantee by stating it cannot confirm the message (e24).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and successfully realizes all target variants. The persona is accurately depicted through requests for plain language explanations and step-by-step confirmations. The STT errors are plausible and handled gracefully by the assistant. Tool usage and business rule adherence are flawless.
